Published

updated

Crypto chart mar17
Harry Rajan

Welcome to Newsweek's cryptocurrency news: in this daily update we will be looking at the movement and outlook for major cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, with a technical analysis.

Meanwhile, the Newsweek Cryptocurrency Index has data on 11 currencies, with individual strength comparisons. [...] On the daily chart, the pair is trading above Tenken-sen ($40,079), Kijun-sen ($39,828), and below Ichimoku Kumo cloud ($41,399) confirming a bullish trend. It hit a high of $41,467 yesterday and is currently trading around $40,832.

Major support - $37,000 (Mar 7th low). Anything below this level would confirm a bearish continuation. A dip till $34,000/$32,950 (Jan 24th low)/$30,000/$28,600. [...] On the daily chart, the pair is trading above Tenken-sen ($2,634), Kijun-sen ($2,672), and below Ichimoku Kumo cloud ($2,873) confirming the bullish trend.

Major support is seen at $2,445, any violation below this level confirms bearish continuation. A dip till $2,300 (Feb 24th low)/$2,150 is likely.

Intraday trend reversal may happen if Ethereum closes above $2,775. A jump to $2,850/$3,000 is possible. Bullish continuation only above $3,300.
